limitations:
##### Limitations.

The overall execution success of Clare is inherently bounded by the capabilities of the backbone LLM and the integrated 3D toolchains. Additionally, while our simulated environment effectively optimizes clarification policies, fully capturing the diversity and unpredictability of real-world human queries remains an ongoing challenge.
